intro1.message: Oh. Um. You're the one Sylvie... the walker. I'm Wick. I do the, um, animals. Well. There aren't any now.

introHerd.message: The sap. Winter before last. I keep the tack oiled anyway. Somebody should. In case.

default.message: Um... yes? Hello. Do you need something?

aboutWick.message: I'm the drover. And the tanner's boy. Pelts for the, um, saddle blankets. And fangs. For the fence. Charms, I mean.

aboutWickCharms.message: Fangs keep things off. Maybe. I label them so I know which ones I tried.

orderOffer.message: Um. I need some things. For the... things. If you have some. Please? It is in your quest panel.

orderProgress.message: What the panel says. No rush. ... well, a little.

orderComplete.message: Oh! That's... perfect. Thank you. Come back in two hours? If that's all right.
